name: When do I need professional coordination instead of a simple plug-and-play hookup?

mainEntity.name: When do I need professional coordination instead of a simple plug-and-play hookup?

acceptedAnswer.text: You need dedicated hookup coordination if you are relocating appliances, switching fuel types, or installing built-in luxury units. Standard kitchen upgrades often involve shifting a sink, moving a gas range to an island, or converting from electric to gas cooking. These adjustments require structural framing cuts, drywall patching, and trade permits. Coordination prevents clearance errors, improper circuit sizing, or water lines colliding with appliance rear panels.
acceptedAnswer.description: You need professional coordination whenever you move appliance locations, switch between gas and electric, or install built-in units requiring new rough plumbing and wiring.
